3.speaker: Narrator
3.text: I looked at the other members of the Golden Guard. They stood stock-still.

4.speaker: Player_Romus
4.text: "Just what is your intention, Titus? Would you be so bold as to take the Crown yourself?"

9.speaker: Hugo Toras
9.text: "Romus, you are dismantling everything the kingdom was built upon."

10.speaker: Hugo Toras
10.text: "I am truly sorry. But there was no other way."

11.speaker: Hugo Toras
11.text: "It's because we are family that I must do this."

12.speaker: Player_Romus
12.text: "Impossible. I don't believe it. We're family."

13.speaker: Narrator
13.text: Titus stepped forward, holding out his hand.

15.speaker: Narrator
15.text: Mother let out a small gasp as Titus turned to Hugo and bowed deeply before him.

16.speaker: Player_Romus
16.text: "You can have it when you pry it from my cold dead hands!"

17.speaker: Narrator
17.text: My uncle took it, his expression one of grim determination.

18.speaker: Titus Gordion
18.text: "Now, I entreat the heads of each noble house to step forward and swear your allegiance to your new king."

19.speaker: Narrator
19.text: Angelica stepped forward first, sparing me a fleeting glance before lowering to one knee.

23.speaker: Angelica Sazon
23.text: "For the good of Rizia, I swear allegiance to King Hugo."

24.speaker: Narrator
24.text: She kissed the ring. Leona repeated the vow and the action.

25.speaker: Narrator
25.text: With effort, Taddeus wheeled himself over.

26.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
26.text: "You’ll forgive my inability to kneel, Your Majesty. But my allegiance is yours."

27.speaker: Narrator
27.text: Hugo nodded, his gaze softening as Taddeus pressed his lips to the ring.

28.speaker: Narrator
28.text: Lucita followed suit, swearing loyalty to the new monarch.
28.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Lucita"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Lucita"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Carlos"] == true) == false)

32.speaker: Narrator
32.text: I kissed the ring. Hugo nodded.

34.speaker: Narrator
34.text: Titus stepped forward, placing a fist over his heart.

36.speaker: Narrator
36.text: The guards and nobles called out in unison, "All Hail King Hugo."

37.speaker: Narrator
37.text: And so, a new chapter in Rizia's history had begun.

38.speaker: Player_Romus
38.text: "This is treason! Take him into custody at once!"

39.speaker: Player_Romus
39.text: "Guards! Prove your loyalty to the Crown and detain Captain Gordion!"

40.speaker: Player_Romus
40.text: "Are you deaf? Do as I command?"

41.speaker: Player_Romus
41.text: "'Fine. I submit. What do you want from me?"

42.speaker: Player_Romus
42.text: "What in God's name are you talking about?"

43.speaker: Player_Romus
43.text: "The rightful king stands before you now!"

46.speaker: Titus Gordion
46.text: "The man whose lineage has remained untouched by the blood of commoners."

47.speaker: Narrator
47.text: The doors of the grand hall swung open and the Golden Guard rushed inside, quickly spreading out to secure the room.

48.speaker: Narrator
48.text: But instead of moving toward the assembled nobles, Titus halted directly in front of me. His men lined up behind him.

49.speaker: Narrator
49.text: The Golden Guard seized me by the arms and dragged me into the adjoining room.

50.speaker: Player_Romus
50.text: "Take it. I don't want it anymore, anyway."

51.speaker: Player_Romus
51.text: "You’ll regret this, Titus. Mark my words."

52.speaker: Player_Romus
52.text: "Enjoy your reign. It will be short."

53.speaker: Player_Romus
53.text: "What dignity remains after losing everything? Not even your mercy can restore what has been taken."

54.speaker: Titus Gordion
54.text: "By the authority vested in me, I hereby declare King Romus is to be taken into custody for treason against the Crown."

55.speaker: Player_Romus
55.text: "What is the meaning of this, Titus? It’s the House nobles you should be after!"

57.speaker: Player_Romus
57.text: "Are you mad?! By what right do you dare to arrest me?"

58.speaker: Player_Romus
58.text: "Treason? Against whom? I am the Crown!"

59.speaker: Titus Gordion
59.text: "Guards, escort him back into the main hall."

65.speaker: Narrator
65.text: Vina's eyes flickered with shock as she struggled to to process what was happening.
65.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Vina"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_RelationshipPublic"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Vina"] == false  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_RelationshipPublic"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Vina"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_RelationshipPublic"] == true) == false)

66.speaker: Narrator
66.text: Everyone else in the trophy room was escorted in as well.

68.speaker: Titus Gordion
68.text: "However, as a sworn protector of the Crown, I could not carry out such an order in good conscience."

69.speaker: Titus Gordion
69.text: "The king brought you here tonight to compel the leaders of your respective Houses to sign a new Rizian constitution--"
69.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Path"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_ViolentAction"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Adarfo_AbdicationPath"] == true) == false)

70.speaker: Player_Romus
70.text: "Yes, it's true. But these reforms are designed to strengthen the monarchy, not destroy it."

73.speaker: Player_Romus
73.text: "People demand change. The monarchy can no longer exist as it once did. These reforms are meant to ensure Rizia’s survival."

74.speaker: Hugo Toras
74.text: "After Captain Gordion informed me of your intention to strip our House -- your own family -- of our titles, I was left with no choice."

75.speaker: Player_Romus
75.text: "No, Mother. You've been misled. I've done no such thing."

76.speaker: Titus Gordion
76.text: "Do you honestly expect anyone to believe that?"

77.speaker: Titus Gordion
77.text: "I'm talking about the man whose lineage has remained untouched by the blood of commoners."

78.speaker: Titus Gordion
78.text: "No. I'm speaking of the man whose lineage has remained untouched by the blood of commoners."

79.speaker: Titus Gordion
79.text: "Rizia cannot survive under a weak monarchy. It deserves a strong leader. One who respects tradition."

80.speaker: Narrator
80.text: The room fell into stunned silence as Hugo stepped forward.

81.speaker: Hugo Toras
81.text: "My God, Romus... you actually want to dismantle everything the kingdom was built upon... lead us into ruin."

82.speaker: Vina Toras
82.text: "Betraying my father like this shows your true character. But then again, you never had any integrity to begin with."

89.speaker: Rico Toras
89.text: "Don't worry, dear. Nothing's changed. You'll still get to be queen, one day. Now please... join me."

90.speaker: Rico Toras
90.text: "Guess that makes me next in line!"

91.speaker: Vina Toras
91.text: "No! Never. I stand with Father, the rightful king!"

92.speaker: Hugo Toras
92.text: "For that, I could not stand idly by."

96.speaker: Player_Romus
96.text: "You don’t owe me any loyalty right now, Vina. If bending the knee to your uncle is what guarantees your place in this world, then do it."

97.speaker: Narrator
97.text: Vina scowled at him as he took a knee.

98.speaker: Player_Romus
98.text: "I know this is hard, Vina, but sometimes survival requires sacrifices."

99.speaker: Player_Romus
99.text: "Thank you, Vina. I knew I could count on you."

100.speaker: Player_Romus
100.text: "You don't need to swear allegiance to him, Vina. Keep your honor. You owe him nothing."

101.speaker: Estela Toras
101.text: "Don't be a fool, dear! Honor means nothing if you're left with nothing."

105.speaker: Vina Toras
105.text: "How can you say that? You'd honestly choose Hugo over your own son?"

106.speaker: Estela Toras
106.text: "But you still have a chance to be queen. Like you always wanted."

107.speaker: Hugo Toras
107.text: "Madam Estela speaks the truth, Your Highness."

108.speaker: Estela Toras
108.text: "You can and you will. There’s no room for pride in this world -- only survival."

109.speaker: Estela Toras
109.text: "Listen to your father. Given the circumstances, you must do what is necessary for your own self-preservation."

110.speaker: Player_Romus
110.text: "Forget it, Hugo. She'll never bow down to you."

112.speaker: Vina Toras
112.text: "I'm not betraying you. I'm ensuring your legacy survives."

114.speaker: Player_Romus
114.text: "You have your whole life ahead of you! This moment, while painful, will soon be nothing more than a fleeting memory."

119.speaker: Narrator
119.text: With that, she knelt next to Rico and they both swore their allegiance to Hugo.

121.speaker: Estela Toras
121.text: "There’s no room for pride in this world -- only survival."

122.speaker: Vina Toras
122.text: "If that is your wish, then I accept my fate."

123.speaker: Vina Toras
123.text: "I hear what you're saying, but my position is unchanged."

124.speaker: Vina Toras
124.text: "If that is your wish, Father, then I will do as you ask."

125.speaker: Narrator
125.text: With tears in her eyes, she knelt next to Rico and they both swore their allegiance to Hugo.

130.speaker: Hugo Toras
130.text: "That's enough, Rico. No sense torturing the girl further."

131.speaker: Narrator
131.text: With tears in her eyes, she knelt and swore her allegiance to Hugo.

132.speaker: Player_Romus
132.text: "I did what I had to, for Rizia -- for you. I hope, one day, you’ll understand why I made the choices I did."

133.speaker: Player_Romus
133.text: "When you become Queen, I hope you don't make the same mistakes I did."

134.speaker: Player_Romus
134.text: "The people of Rizia deserve a champion. Don't let them down."

135.speaker: Vina Toras
135.text: "I understand. But I still can't forgive you."

136.speaker: Player_Romus
136.text: "What happened to your ideals, Vina? You would betray your own father so easily?"

137.speaker: Narrator
137.text: Titus gave a slight bow before signaling to Sevrio, whose men took him away.

138.speaker: Titus Gordion
138.text: "It need not come to that. A simple gesture will suffice."

140.speaker: Titus Gordion
140.text: "Thank you for putting up so little resistance."

141.speaker: Titus Gordion
141.text: "I regret nothing. This is the only way to restore what’s been lost."

145.speaker: Narrator
145.text: The Golden Guard seized me by the arms and propelled me forward. Lucita rushed at them.

148.speaker: Narrator
148.text: Titus held her back as his guards dragged me into the adjoining room.

155.speaker: Narrator
155.text: Both Vina and Pabel's eyes flickered with shock as they struggled to to process what was happening.

156.speaker: Narrator
156.text: Pabel's eyes flickered with shock as he struggled to to process what was happening.

159.speaker: Titus Gordion
159.text: "I am of humble birth, unworthy of the throne. Rizia needs someone whose ancestry is untouched by the blood of the commoner."

160.speaker: Narrator
160.text: Leona stepped forward first, sparing me a fleeting glance before lowering to one knee.

161.speaker: Leona Sazon
161.text: "For the good of Rizia, I swear allegiance to King Hugo."

166.speaker: Hugo Toras
166.text: "I'm not going to hurt him, but I also can't let his treachery go unpunished."

168.speaker: Hugo Toras
168.text: "I can and I will. You never should have been allowed into Rizia in the first place."

170.speaker: Player_Romus
170.text: "If this is the life you want, Vina, then so be it. I won’t try to hold you back."

171.speaker: Player_Romus
171.text: "Don't be foolish, Vina. You'd be throwing your life away!"

172.speaker: Player_Romus
172.text: "If you believe you must follow him, do what your heart tells you. Just know I will always love you, no matter what."

173.speaker: Estela Toras
173.text: "Have you lost your mind, Romus? She will do no such thing!"

175.speaker: Vina Toras
175.text: "I was taught to honor what’s right, to stand firm even when the cost is high."

176.speaker: Estela Toras
176.text: "Yes, but honor means nothing if you're left with nothing."

177.speaker: Estela Toras
177.text: "Love is clouding your judgment, sweetheart. Until and unless your cousin procreates, you're still third in line for the throne."

178.speaker: Player_Romus
178.text: "Honor is nothing but a myth we tell ourselves to justify the pain. Stop encouraging her to believe in something so hollow."

179.speaker: Player_Romus
179.text: "Mother's right. Forget what said. Your place is here. In Rizia."

181.speaker: Vina Toras
181.text: "If exile is your fate, then it is mine as well."

182.speaker: Manus Sazon
182.text: "If you truly love me, Vina, you'll let me go. Please don't throw your life away on my account."

183.speaker: Manus Sazon
183.text: "Listen to you father. If you truly love me, Vina, you'll let me go. Please don't throw your life away on my account."

184.speaker: Hugo Toras
184.text: "Consider this my first act of benevolence as king -- a gesture to show the world that even traitors such as yourself are treated with dignity."

185.speaker: Estela Toras
185.text: "Don’t be naive, Romus. She must do what’s best for her future, just as I did."

189.speaker: Titus Gordion
189.text: "How should we deal with him, Your Majesty?"

190.speaker: Player_Romus
190.text: "You'd let me go? After everything I did?"

193.speaker: Hugo Toras
193.text: "I can't let his treachery go unpunished."

194.speaker: Hugo Toras
194.text: "You shall be exiled, just as your mother was before you."

198.speaker: Hugo Toras
198.text: "You never should have been allowed into Rizia in the first place."

199.speaker: Hugo Toras
199.text: "You're lucky to be spared this fate. See to his removal at once, Titus."

200.speaker: Player_Romus
200.text: "You will not follow him into exile! I forbid it!"

201.speaker: Narrator
201.text: Titus gave a slight bow before signaling for his guard, who then took him away.

202.speaker: Manus Sazon
202.text: "Please, Your Grace. The reformist movement will not go away. The Crown can't simply ignore it forever--"

203.speaker: Narrator
203.text: A tense silence settled over the room. Taddeus broke it, wheeling himself toward Hugo.

208.speaker: Player_Romus
208.text: "If she wants to throw her life away, that's her choice."

209.speaker: Vina Toras
209.text: "I swore an oath... 'Til death do us part.' I'm not leaving you."

215.speaker: Narrator
215.text: Through the rush of it all, I saw Vina, her mouth wide in shock.

222.speaker: Narrator
222.text: Through the rush of it all, I saw Lucita frozen in disbelief.

229.speaker: Narrator
229.text: As the guards dragged me out, Titus's voice cut through the struggle.

231.speaker: Narrator
231.text: The hall erupted with the same cry, sealing my fate.

232.text: Through the rush of it all, I saw Pabel frozen in disbelief.

240.text: Vina consoled my mother as tears began to fall from her eyes.

241.speaker: Narrator
241.text: Manus took Vina in his arms as tears began to fall from my daughter's eyes.

245.speaker: Hugo Toras
245.text: "If that's how you feel, I will not stop you from accompanying your husband."

247.speaker: Narrator
247.text: Vina rushed to Manus and held him tightly.

248.speaker: Vina Toras
248.text: "Don’t pretend you have any authority over me!"

249.speaker: Vina Toras
249.text: "Don’t pretend you have any authority over me after everything you've done!"

250.speaker: Estela Toras
250.text: "No, Vina. He's right. Listen to your father."

251.speaker: Estela Toras
251.text: "Have you lost your senses, Romus? She will do no such thing!"

253.speaker: Player_Romus
253.text: "You are the king. As it should be."

254.speaker: Player_Romus
254.text: "Your act of 'benevolence' means nothing to me. I will not grovel before you."

255.speaker: Player_Romus
255.text: "I will not kneel. Even for my family's sake, I cannot betray what I know to be right."

256.speaker: Player_Romus
256.text: "I will not kneel to you or any other so-called monarch. The age of kings is over."

257.speaker: Hugo Toras
257.text: "I offered you a choice, but you have forced my hand."

258.speaker: Hugo Toras
258.text: "Titus, see that the king's decree is fulfilled."

259.speaker: Narrator
259.text: Rough hands seized me with a brutality that stripped away my last vestiges of power.

267.speaker: Narrator
267.text: Lucita stepped forward, head high and strides deliberate.
267.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Lucita"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Carlos"] == true) == false)

268.speaker: Player_Romus
268.text: "So, this is how you repay me, Lucita? A bow to the man who took everything from us?"

269.speaker: Lucita Azaro
269.text: "You misunderstand my intentions, Romus. I'm here to state before everyone here that I have no intention of kneeling before anyone."

270.speaker: Player_Romus
270.text: "That's my girl. Tell it to him straight."

275.speaker: Vina Toras
275.text: "I could never kneel to him while you still stand. I couldn't live with myself."

276.speaker: Vina Toras
276.text: "That's not the kind of sacrifice I'm willing to make. You’re my father! I could never kneel to him while you still stand. I couldn't live with myself."

277.speaker: Vina Toras
277.text: "You married me to Ricardus so House Toras would stay on the throne. And that's exactly what's going to happen."

278.speaker: Vina Toras
278.text: "You think I want to kneel next to you, Rico? Fine. But don’t think for a second I’m doing this for you."

281.speaker: Titus Gordion
281.text: "The House nobles didn't betray their kingdom. You did."

285.speaker: Axel Reinhart
285.text: "If these allegations are true, then needless to say I am shocked and outraged."

286.speaker: Estela Toras
286.text: "Alright, Vina. That's enough. This isn't the time for defiance."

287.speaker: Axel Reinhart
287.text: "But Pales will not unify with a Rizia ruled by King Hugo Toras."

288.speaker: Narrator
288.text: Several Wruhec's Guardians seized me by the arms and propelled me forward. Lucita rushed at them.

289.speaker: Narrator
289.text: Several Wruhec's Guardians seized me by the arms and dragged me into the adjoining room.

293.speaker: Titus Gordion
293.text: "Rizian nobles, hear me. I have dedicated my life to serving the Crown, but today I stand before you with a heavy heart."

297.speaker: Titus Gordion
297.text: "As you already know, the king brought you here tonight to compel the leaders of your respective Houses to sign a new Rizian constitution--"
297.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Path"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_ViolentAction"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_ReformTalks_ViolentPlanB"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Adarfo_AbdicationPath"] == true) == false)

298.speaker: Titus Gordion
298.text: "One that would strip you of your titles, lands, privileges, and ancestral rights."

299.speaker: Titus Gordion
299.text: "A constitution that aims to dismantle centuries of tradition and the monarchy itself."

300.speaker: Titus Gordion
300.text: "And if you refused, he intended to secure your consent by force."

302.speaker: Player_Romus
302.text: "You are completely out of line, Titus."

311.speaker: Vina Toras
311.text: "It’s in moments like these that true character is revealed. Shame on you for turning on my father in his darkest hours!"
311.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Rico"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Vina"] > 1) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Vina"] == false  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == true) == false)

312.speaker: Vina Toras
312.text: "No! Don’t try to turn this around on me."

313.speaker: Narrator
313.text: And then, to my shock, Vina approached Hugo.
313.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Rico"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Vina"] > 1) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Vina"] == false  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == true) == false)

315.speaker: Player_Romus
315.text: "You have every right to be disappointed with my actions here today."

316.speaker: Player_Romus
316.text: "After everything I've done for you, this is how you repay me."

317.speaker: Vina Toras
317.text: "Not only have you shattered the trust of the people but also my trust in you. I can't follow someone who has lost their way."

319.speaker: Player_Romus
319.text: "I was trying to save Rizia from itself. You just don’t see the bigger picture."

320.speaker: Player_Romus
320.text: "If my own daughter sees me as a failure, then perhaps you are no daughter of mine."

321.speaker: Narrator
321.text: With that, she knelt before Hugo and swore her allegiance.

323.speaker: Player_Romus
323.text: "Everything I did was for the good of the kingdom and for you. I only hope, in time, you’ll understand."

324.speaker: Vina Toras
324.text: "Even now your arrogance continues to blind you. Your 'bigger picture' is nothing more than an illusion."

325.speaker: Vina Toras
325.text: "If that's what you think, then you've lost more than just your way."

326.speaker: Vina Toras
326.text: "Good intentions won’t erase the damage you've done."

327.speaker: Narrator
327.text: With tears in her eyes, she knelt before Hugo and swore her allegiance.

330.speaker: Player_Romus
330.text: "You think your position is secure? People like you don't tend to last long."

331.speaker: Player_Romus
331.text: "I’m sure you’ll make a fine king... for about five minutes."

332.speaker: Narrator
332.text: He took a knee and swore his allegiance.

340.speaker: Narrator
340.text: With tears in her eyes, she knelt before Hugo. Axel joined her, and together they swore their allegiance.

341.speaker: Narrator
341.text: With that, she knelt before Hugo. Axel joined her, and together they swore their allegiance.

342.speaker: Narrator
342.text: Lucita stepped back and stood by my side.

343.speaker: Narrator
343.text: The doors of the grand hall swung open. Sevrio Castellanus and a team of Wruhec's Guardians rushed inside, quickly spreading out to secure the room.

344.speaker: Titus Gordion
344.text: "Right is defined by the oath I swore -- to defend the Crown's true purpose, not the whims of a single monarch."

345.speaker: Titus Gordion
345.text: "Rectifying a wrong that should have never occurred."

350.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
350.text: "The room is secure. By God's grace, the Guardians stand ready."

351.speaker: Titus Gordion
351.text: "The man I swore to protect, King Romus, intended to strike against House Toras -- his own blood."
351.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Path"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_ViolentAction"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_ReformTalks_ViolentPlanB"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Adarfo_AbdicationPath"] == true) == false)

352.speaker: Titus Gordion
352.text: "I witnessed his malice myself. I begged him to resolve his disputes with House Toras through words.'"

353.speaker: Player_Romus
353.text: "I never meant to harm you, nor Vina. House Toras had become a threat, and I had no choice but to act."

356.speaker: Player_Romus
356.text: "It was Titus' idea! He forced me into it."

358.speaker: Titus Gordion
358.text: "I'm only a humble guardsman. I cannot force the King to do anything."

359.speaker: Player_Romus
359.text: "I don't believe it... this can't be happening..."

361.speaker: Titus Gordion
361.text: "But he dismissed my counsel, intent on resorting to violent means."

362.speaker: Titus Gordion
362.text: "I did not want to risk bringing violence upon myself, so I went along with his plan. I even advised him on it."

363.speaker: Titus Gordion
363.text: "Today, I hope to rectify that mistake by shielding Rizia from a king who has placed his selfish desires above the needs of the kingdom."

364.speaker: Titus Gordion
364.text: "It belongs to the rightful king of Rizia."

365.speaker: Estela Toras
365.text: "Romus. You wouldn't really be so boneheaded as to attack your own family?"

366.speaker: Player_Romus
366.text: "Don't listen to him, Mother! Titus is lying. He just wants to overthrow me, to take the throne for himself!"

367.speaker: Titus Gordion
367.text: "I have no interest in the throne, Your Majesty. It is not mine to take."

369.speaker: Player_Romus
369.text: "After all I've done, this is how I’m repaid?"

372.speaker: Lucita Azaro
372.text: "I stand by my husband -- the father of my child -- and the rightful king of Rizia. My fate is sealed with his."

373.speaker: Hugo Toras
373.text: "Very well. His path will be determined soon enough."

374.speaker: Titus Gordion
374.text: "I first grew suspicious when the king began acting outside the usual protocols, such as dismissing advice and taking meetings behind closed doors."

375.speaker: Titus Gordion
375.text: "When I dug deeper, I discovered he had been secretly conspiring to implement the radical reforms I spoke of."
375.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_ViolentAction_Adarfo_SecurityPlansObtained"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_ViolentAction_Adarfo_HiddenStaff"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_ViolentAction_Deploy_RustyPMC"] == true) == false)

376.speaker: Titus Gordion
376.text: "As a sworn protector of the Crown, I could not allow this."

383.speaker: Narrator
383.text: I looked to Captain Castellanus. He stood stock-still.

385.speaker: Narrator
385.text: Mother let out a small gasp as Titus turned to Hugo and bowed deeply before him. Sevrio did the same.

392.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
392.text: "Please, Your Majesty, you're only making this worse for yourself."

396.speaker: Titus Gordion
396.text: "They only take orders from the rightful king of Rizia."

407.speaker: Titus Gordion
407.text: "The king brought you here tonight to force the leaders of your respective Houses to abolish the Rizian monarchy."

408.speaker: Titus Gordion
408.text: "Instead, he envisioned the complete dismantling of the existing order -- stripping you of your titles, lands, privileges, and ancestral rights."

412.speaker: Titus Gordion
412.text: "He has been collaborating in secret with the terrorist leader, Adarfo Sotelato, and his criminal organization to achieve his aims."

419.speaker: Narrator
419.text: Titus halted directly in front of me. His men lined up behind him.

420.speaker: Narrator
420.text: But instead of moving toward the assembled nobles, Sevrio halted directly in front of me. His men lined up behind him.

433.speaker: Titus Gordion
433.text: "He tried to leak the security plans of today's gathering to armed extremists."

434.speaker: Titus Gordion
434.text: "He tried to sneak armed extremists into today's gathering. Disguised as kitchen staff."

438.speaker: Titus Gordion
438.text: "He has been collaborating in secret with foreign agents to achieve his aims."

442.speaker: Titus Gordion
442.text: "He tried to involve Arcasian agents to strike you at today's gathering."
442.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_ViolentAction_Adarfo_SecurityPlansObtained"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_ViolentAction_Adarfo_HiddenStaff"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_ViolentAction_Deploy_RustyPMC"] == true)

446.speaker: Manus Sazon
446.text: "And the last thing I wanted was to allow a bloodthirsty Malenyevist to run roughshod over the country."

447.speaker: Titus Gordion
447.text: "It was his intention to abdicate the throne, but he never planned to appoint a successor."

450.speaker: Player_Romus
450.text: "Everyone remain right where you are. Your reckoning is at hand."

451.speaker: Narrator
451.text: Titus looked me straight in the eye. He spoke slowly.

452.speaker: Titus Gordion
452.text: "What you do not know is that he was counting on you to refuse. All along, his intention was to secure your consent by force."

453.speaker: Titus Gordion
453.text: "What I want is your fealty to the rightful king of Rizia."

454.speaker: Player_Romus
454.text: "I don't understand. You and House Toras supported the reforms."

458.speaker: Hugo Toras
458.text: "I did until you proved you were willing to stoop to violence to force your agenda."

462.speaker: Hugo Toras
462.text: "I would have gladly supported your reforms. But not after you proved you were willing to stoop to violence to force your agenda."

463.speaker: Hugo Toras
463.text: "I did not support your reforms, but I would have been willing to help implement them if the other Houses insisted. But then you proved you were willing to stoop to violence to force your agenda."

468.speaker: Narrator
468.text: I removed the royal signet ring and placed it in Titus's palm. He turned and knelt before Hugo, presenting the ring to him.

469.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
469.text: Hit him in his weak spot.

473.speaker: Narrator
473.text: He turned and knelt before Hugo, presenting the ring to him.

474.speaker: Narrator
474.text: As he collapsed to the floor in pain, his guardsmen swarmed me, raining blows until I was forced to give up the ring.

475.speaker: Narrator
475.text: With a groan, Titus rose and presented it to Hugo.

476.speaker: Narrator
476.text: As he collapsed to the floor in pain, Sevrio and his guardsmen swarmed me, raining blows until I was forced to give up the ring.

478.speaker: Narrator
478.text: Manus remained standing, a conflicted look on his face.

482.speaker: Narrator
482.text: Before he could act, Titus grabbed him by the shoulders.

486.speaker: Titus Gordion
486.text: "Not so fast, Mr. Sazon. You're no less complicit than our former king."

487.speaker: Manus Sazon
487.text: "What do you mean? I had no idea of His Majesty's plans."

488.speaker: Manus Sazon
488.text: "I advised His Majesty not to go down the path of violence. He didn't listen."

492.speaker: Manus Sazon
492.text: "But yes, I collaborated with King Romus on the reforms. And I stand by them."

493.speaker: Hugo Toras
493.text: "You were the one who started this movement. Sotelato may have radicalized it, but he was riding your coattails."

494.speaker: Hugo Toras
494.text: "You would've betrayed the Rizian crown and everything it stands for."

495.speaker: Player_Romus
495.text: "You took my daughter away. I hope you're happy, Hugo."

496.speaker: Player_Romus
496.text: "Go on, you two. You'll be better off outside of Rizia than in it."

497.speaker: Player_Romus
497.text: "See, Titus? Not everyone in this room recognizes Hugo as their king."

498.speaker: Titus Gordion
498.text: "We will see about that. General Taddeus?"

499.speaker: Narrator
499.text: My daughter looked at me tearfully.

509.speaker: Narrator
509.text: Lucita and Carlos followed suit, swearing loyalty to the new monarch.
509.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Lucita"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Lucita"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Carlos"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Carlos"] == true) == false)

510.speaker: Narrator
510.text: Carlos followed suit, swearing loyalty to the new monarch.
510.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Lucita"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Lucita"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Carlos"] == true) == false)

521.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
521.text: "When we reclaim Pales, we will do so in the name of King Hugo Toras."

526.speaker: Player_Romus
526.text: "I knew Queen Lucita would not stand for this nonsense."

531.speaker: Narrator
531.text: Gasps rippled through the room as everyone turned towards my wife.

532.speaker: Titus Gordion
532.text: "The King and Queen conspired to carry out this act together. They deserve each other."

537.speaker: Vina Toras
537.text: "You had the chance to transform the country, and instead you schemed against your own family. I can't follow someone who's lost their way."

541.speaker: Narrator
541.text: She and Axel exchanged glances. Axel gave a nod of confirmation.

545.speaker: Axel Reinhart
545.text: "But I side with my Duchess. Pales will not recognize Hugo Toras as king."

547.speaker: Estela Toras
547.text: "My lot's been cast already, darling. Your uncle never wanted me in the royal family, anyway."

551.speaker: Estela Toras
551.text: "But you still have a chance to be queen. There's no telling what will happen to your cousin, after all."
551.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Rico"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Extradited"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Rico"] == true)

556.speaker: Estela Toras
556.text: "But you still have a chance to be queen. In the very likely event that your disgraced cousin doesn't procreate."
556.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Rico"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Extradited"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Rico"] == true) == false)

557.speaker: Player_Romus
557.text: "No! The reunification must go as planned! It's my legacy!"

559.speaker: Hugo Toras
559.text: "Just as I hope you understand that I will not recognize Vina Toras' claim to the throne. When I die, Hubertus Toras and his family will be next in line."

563.speaker: Hugo Toras
563.text: "Just as I hope you understand that I will not recognize Vina Toras' claim to the throne. Should anything happen to my son, Hubertus Toras and his family will be next in line."

564.speaker: Axel Reinhart
564.text: "I believe this betrayal will be your legacy. Dad."

565.speaker: Player_Romus
565.text: "Good. Keep my daughter safe in the Grand Duchy."

567.speaker: Player_Romus
567.text: "You two are both delusional. Pledge your support to Hugo, and all will be well."

568.speaker: Vina Toras
568.text: "Father, no! How can you ask us to do that?"

569.speaker: Vina Toras
569.text: "Fine. I don't care what happens in this sham of a kingdom."

570.speaker: Estela Toras
570.text: "Vina, please! Don't throw your future away. Swear your allegiance to your uncle."

571.speaker: Hugo Toras
571.text: "My son's reputation will be rehabilitated. But your mother speaks the truth, Your Highness."

572.speaker: Hugo Toras
572.text: "Recognize me as the rightful King of Rizia, and you will keep your title and your place in the line of succession."

573.speaker: Player_Romus
573.text: "You truly don't know my daughter if you think she wants to remain part of the monarchy."
573.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Adarfo_AbdicationPath"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Path"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_DuchessOfValenqiris"] == true) == false)

577.speaker: Player_Romus
577.text: "Vina, I beg you, if you don't want to do it for yourself, do it for me. I’ll carry no resentment in my heart."

583.speaker: Narrator
583.text: She stood next to Axel and folded her arms.

590.speaker: Narrator
590.text: She folded her arms and glared at Rico.

596.speaker: Vina Toras
596.text: "I will not be a Duchess in service to the man who usurped my father."

597.speaker: Vina Toras
597.text: "I am the Grand Duchess of Pales. That's the only title I need, and you can't take it away from me."

598.speaker: Vina Toras
598.text: "No title is worth staying married to this idiot while serving his usurper of a father."

599.speaker: Rico Toras
599.text: "You rat. You can't say those words and expect to live."

601.speaker: Hugo Toras
601.text: "Your loyalty to your father is touching, Your Highness. I would have made the same choice in your place."

602.speaker: Hugo Toras
602.text: "Go to Pales. Go, and never set foot on Rizian soil again."

610.speaker: Vina Toras
610.text: "The revolution's going to eat you all alive, anyway."

611.speaker: Hugo Toras
611.text: "But I cannot let you stay in Rizia."

613.speaker: Narrator
613.text: One by one, the others in the room pledged their loyalty to the new king until only my mother and I were left.
613.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Vina"] == false  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Axel"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Axel"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Manus"] == true) == false)

620.speaker: Narrator
620.text: She rushed to Manus' side and embraced him tenderly.

621.speaker: Vina Toras
621.text: "Now that I'm not a princess, none of you can stop me from being with the man I love."

623.speaker: Hugo Toras
623.text: "If his plans had succeeded, he would've gotten us all killed."

627.speaker: Hugo Toras
627.text: "He would have destroyed House Toras. Valero's legacy!"

628.speaker: Hugo Toras
628.text: "By all rights, he should spend the rest of his life in prison."

629.speaker: Player_Romus
629.text: "Go on, I dare you to do it. Bring even more shame upon your house."

633.speaker: Player_Romus
633.text: "You hypocrite. You beg me for a pardon for your son, then send me to jail?"

634.speaker: Player_Romus
634.text: "I am the true king of Rizia! My followers will not stand for this."

635.speaker: Player_Romus
635.text: "Don't you understand? It doesn't matter! The revolutionaries will have all of our heads!"

640.speaker: Hugo Toras
640.text: "The revolutionaries will calm down once Rizia is governed by a reasonable and just king."

641.speaker: Hugo Toras
641.text: "Few in this room have accepted your treachery. What makes you think the kingdom will?"

642.speaker: Hugo Toras
642.text: "I said you *should* be imprisoned. Not that you will."

643.speaker: Hugo Toras
643.text: "If that was how I treated members of my own family, I'd be no better than you."

644.speaker: Hugo Toras
644.text: "Perhaps not today, but someday, you will come to see the error of your ways."

645.speaker: Narrator
645.text: Sorrow and compassion mixed in his eyes.

646.speaker: Hugo Toras
646.text: "Here is what I can offer you. Recognize me as king of Rizia and shed your claim to the throne, and I will let you leave the kingdom in peace."

647.speaker: Hugo Toras
647.text: "You may join your daughter and her paramour in exile."

654.speaker: Hugo Toras
654.text: "You may join your daughter in exile."
654.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_VinaExiled"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_ManusExiled"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Axel"] == false) == false)

661.speaker: Titus Gordion
661.text: "And his co-conspirator, Duchess Azaro? I don't trust her one bit."
661.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_VinaExiled"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCSupport.Journal_Turn10_Birthday_Lucita_NoKneel"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn09_TalkWithTitus_InformLucitaOfPlan"] == true)

662.speaker: Hugo Toras
662.text: "She shall be exiled as well. Without the Azaros to back her, she will not be a danger."

663.speaker: Hugo Toras
663.text: "Your wife is free to go as well. Presuming the child she is carrying never sets foot on Rizian soil again."
663.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_VinaExiled"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCSupport.Journal_Turn10_Birthday_Lucita_NoKneel"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn09_TalkWithTitus_InformLucitaOfPlan"] == true) == false)

664.speaker: Hugo Toras
664.text: "Your... friend is free to go as well. And I suggest he take the chance, before such perversions as yours and his are once more outlawed."
664.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_VinaExiled"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCSupport.Journal_Turn10_Birthday_Lucita_NoKneel"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_RelationshipPublic"] == true)

670.speaker: Narrator
670.text: My mother walked over to stand beside me.
670.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_VinaExiled"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCSupport.Journal_Turn10_Birthday_Lucita_NoKneel"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_RelationshipPublic"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_Gone"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Pabel"] > 3  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_Lord"] == false) == false)

671.speaker: Estela Toras
671.text: "You've gotten what you've always wanted, Hugo. The stain of commoner blood has been washed out of the Toras lineage."

672.speaker: Estela Toras
672.text: "Romus will obey your order. And I'll accompany him to make sure he stays out of trouble."

674.speaker: Narrator
674.text: Her voice was tinged with desperation.

678.speaker: Hugo Toras
678.text: "Unlike you, humor isn't my strong suit."

682.speaker: Player_Romus
682.text: "You've got to leave Rizia as well, Hugo. I'm telling you, if we don't give the reformists what they want, everyone in this room will die."

685.speaker: Player_Romus
685.text: "I'll die before I cede the throne to you."

696.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
696.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_ManusExiled"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_VinaExiled"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Axel"] == false) == false

700.speaker: Narrator
700.text: Tears began to fall from my mother's eyes.
700.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_ManusExiled"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_VinaExiled"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Axel"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Vina"] == true) == false)

707.speaker: Lucita Azaro
707.text: "What were you thinking, Romus? Your pride has doomed our child!"

708.speaker: Narrator
708.text: Lucita's fists curled up with rage.

709.speaker: Lucita Azaro
709.text: "What were you thinking, Romus? Our child could have ruled Rizia!"

715.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
715.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_ManusExiled"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_VinaExiled"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Axel"] == false) == false

735.speaker: Narrator
735.text: A mirthless laugh escaped her lips.

736.speaker: Lucita Azaro
736.text: "If you had your way, you would've killed my family along with your uncle's."

739.speaker: Lucita Azaro
739.text: "Your Majesty, I pledge my support to you and cede my future child's claim to the Rizian throne. As long as you can guarantee our safety."

741.speaker: Hugo Toras
741.text: "You, your family and your child will all be safe, Duchess Azaro."

743.speaker: Lucita Azaro
743.text: "There's nothing left for us here, Romus. I'll follow you wherever you go."

744.speaker: Pabel Adria
744.text: "Rizia will fall under your reign. Your Grace."

749.speaker: Hugo Toras
749.text: "I know of your intentions against the monarchy and the Toras dynasty."

750.speaker: Manus Sazon
750.text: "What do you mean? I had no idea of His Majesty's plans."

751.speaker: Hugo Toras
751.text: "Because you have your own grand plans, Mr. Sazon."

752.speaker: Hugo Toras
752.text: "If given the opportunity, you would've betrayed the Rizian crown and everything it stands for."

757.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
757.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_Gone"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Pabel"] > 3  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_Lord"] == false

758.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
758.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_Gone"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Pabel"] > 3  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_Lord"] == false) == false

759.speaker: Pabel Adria
759.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_VinaExiled"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCSupport.Journal_Turn10_Birthday_Lucita_NoKneel"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_RelationshipPublic"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_Gone"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Pabel"] > 3  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_Lord"] == false)

760.speaker: Narrator
760.text: Everyone looked at my butler in surprise -- except my mother, who didn't lift an eyebrow.

761.speaker: Pabel Adria
761.text: "I apologize, Your Grace, but my duties are to the King of Rizia. And I will continue to serve him, wherever he goes."

765.speaker: Narrator
765.text: Everyone looked at my butler in surprise.
